<svg viewBox="0 0 760 560" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="760" height="560" fill="#fffdf8"/>
  <text x="380" y="26" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15.5" font-weight="700" fill="#1c1917">Les lingots de fer dans le mikve : la sougya du davar che-eino mitkaven</text>
  <text x="380" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.4" fill="#57534e">Quatre coups : le fait, l'objection, deux réponses, la contre-attaque, la solution -- et deux lectures de la solution.</text>

  <rect x="180" y="62" width="400" height="42" rx="7" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="380" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.4" font-weight="700" fill="#1c1917">Baraita de Rabbi Yehouda</text>
  <text x="380" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.2" fill="#57534e">On chauffe des lingots la veille, on les jette dans l'eau froide du mikve</text>
  <line x1="380" y1="104" x2="380" y2="128" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#ts1)"/>

  <rect x="200" y="128" width="360" height="40" rx="7" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <text x="380" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.2" font-weight="700" fill="#7f1d1d">Objection : ve-halo metsaref !</text>
  <text x="380" y="161" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.2" fill="#991b1b">Le fer chaud plongé dans l'eau se trempe : c'est makeh be-patich</text>
  <line x1="380" y1="168" x2="380" y2="192" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#ts1)"/>

  <rect x="46" y="192" width="316" height="66" rx="7" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#047857" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <text x="204" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#064e3b">Réponse 1 -- Rav Bibi</text>
  <text x="204" y="229" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.3" fill="#065f46">Le fer n'avait pas atteint le point de tsirouf :</text>
  <text x="204" y="244" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.3" fill="#065f46">déjà à demi refroidi, il ne durcit pas.</text>

  <rect x="398" y="192" width="316" height="66" rx="7" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <text x="556" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1e3a8a">Réponse 2 -- Abaye</text>
  <text x="556" y="229" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.3" fill="#1e40af">Même s'il atteint le tsirouf : c'est un</text>
  <text x="556" y="244" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.3" fill="#1e40af">davar che-eino mitkaven, donc permis.</text>
  <line x1="556" y1="258" x2="556" y2="282" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#ts1)"/>

  <rect x="360" y="282" width="380" height="56" rx="7" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <text x="550" y="301" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#7f1d1d">Contre-attaque : Abaye contre Abaye</text>
  <text x="550" y="317" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.2" fill="#991b1b">Sur la mila au travers d'une bahereth, Abaye a expliqué que</text>
  <text x="550" y="331" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.2" fill="#991b1b">le verset est requis pour R. Yehouda : eino mitkaven est INTERDIT.</text>
  <line x1="550" y1="338" x2="550" y2="362" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#ts1)"/>

  <rect x="200" y="362" width="520" height="46" rx="7" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="460" y="381" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.4" font-weight="700" fill="#78350f">Réponse : hanei milei be-khôl haTora koula -- aval hakha tsirouf de-rabanan</text>
  <text x="460" y="398" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.3" fill="#92400e">L'interdit de R. Yehouda vaut pour le reste de la Tora ; ici l'enjeu n'est que rabbinique.</text>

  <text x="380" y="434" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.4" font-weight="700" fill="#1c1917">Deux lectures de cette réponse</text>

  <rect x="34" y="444" width="340" height="100" rx="8" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="204" y="464" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.8" font-weight="700" fill="#1c1917">Rachi</text>
  <text x="204" y="482" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#44403c">Efface les mots ein chevout ba-mikdach.</text>
  <text x="204" y="497" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#44403c">Puisque même avec intention il n'y aurait pas</text>
  <text x="204" y="511" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#44403c">d'interdit de la Tora, les Sages n'ont rien décrété</text>
  <text x="204" y="525" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#44403c">sans intention -- même hors du Temple.</text>
  <text x="204" y="539" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.6" font-style="italic" fill="#78716c">Tout se joue sur le statut derabanan du tsirouf.</text>

  <rect x="392" y="444" width="334" height="100" rx="8" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="559" y="464" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11.8" font-weight="700" fill="#14532d">Ri (Tossefot)</text>
  <text x="559" y="482" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#166534">Garde ein chevout ba-mikdach.</text>
  <text x="559" y="497" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#166534">Chabbat exige melekhet mahchevet : sans intention,</text>
  <text x="559" y="511" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#166534">pas d'interdit de la Tora -- seulement derabanan,</text>
  <text x="559" y="525" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#166534">et au Temple on ne tient pas les chevout.</text>
  <text x="559" y="539" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.6" font-style="italic" fill="#4d7c0f">Tout se joue sur la spécificité de Chabbat.</text>

  <defs>
    <marker id="ts1" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="7" refY="4.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,4.5 L0,9 z" fill="#78716c"/></marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
schemas.legende: La sougya des lingots de fer : de la baraita de Rabbi Yehouda jusqu'aux deux lectures - Rachi et le Ri - de la réponse finale.

<svg viewBox="0 0 760 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="760" height="400" fill="#fffdf8"/>

  <text x="380" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.4" fill="#57534e">1 maneh = 100 zouz. Dans les deux avis, ceux du matin valent un tiers de plus que ceux de l'après-midi.</text>

  <!-- axe -->
  <line x1="230" y1="330" x2="720" y2="330" stroke="#a8a29e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="230" y="348" font-size="9.4" fill="#78716c">0</text>
  <text x="720" y="348" text-anchor="end" font-size="9.4" fill="#78716c">1800 zouz</text>

  <!-- R. MEIR -->
  <text x="34" y="96" font-size="12.6" font-weight="700" fill="#78350f">Rabbi Meir</text>
  <text x="34" y="112" font-size="9.8" fill="#92400e">le prix est nommé, pas le total</text>

  <text x="222" y="97" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.6" fill="#1c1917">Matin -- lin de Pelousim</text>
  <rect x="230" y="84" width="326" height="20" rx="3" fill="#fcd34d" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="566" y="99" font-size="10.4" font-weight="700" fill="#78350f">12 maneh = 1200 zouz</text>

  <text x="222" y="127" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.6" fill="#1c1917">Après-midi -- lin de l'Inde</text>
  <rect x="230" y="114" width="218" height="20" rx="3" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="458" y="129" font-size="10.4" font-weight="700" fill="#78350f">800 zouz</text>

  <text x="230" y="154" font-size="9.8" fill="#57534e">Total implicite : 20 maneh. Tossefot s'étonne que la michna n'écrive ni 8 maneh ni le total.</text>

  <line x1="34" y1="176" x2="726" y2="176" stroke="#e7e5e4" stroke-width="1.4"/>

  <!-- RABBANAN -->
  <text x="34" y="212" font-size="12.6" font-weight="700" fill="#1e3a8a">Les Sages</text>
  <text x="34" y="228" font-size="9.8" fill="#1e40af">le total est nommé : 30 maneh</text>

  <text x="222" y="213" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.6" fill="#1c1917">Matin</text>
  <rect x="230" y="200" width="490" height="20" rx="3" fill="#93c5fd" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="700" y="215" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.4" font-weight="700" fill="#1e3a8a">18 maneh = 1800 zouz</text>

  <text x="222" y="243" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.6" fill="#1c1917">Après-midi</text>
  <rect x="230" y="230" width="326" height="20" rx="3" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="566" y="245" font-size="10.4" font-weight="700" fill="#1e3a8a">12 maneh = 1200 zouz</text>

  <rect x="230" y="262" width="490" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
  <text x="475" y="275" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#1e3a8a">Total : 30 maneh</text>

  <rect x="34" y="296" width="180" height="72" rx="8" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="124" y="315" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.6" font-weight="700" fill="#5b21b6">Qui paie ?</text>
  <text x="124" y="332" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.8" fill="#4c1d95">Les 30 maneh : la communauté.</text>
  <text x="124" y="346" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.8" fill="#4c1d95">Au-delà : le Cohen gadol,</text>
  <text x="124" y="360" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.8" fill="#4c1d95">de sa propre bourse.</text>

  <text x="475" y="370" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.8" font-style="italic" fill="#78716c">Rosh : la répartition 18/12 n'est pas rigide -- ce qui compte, c'est que le matin l'emporte et que le total fasse 30 maneh.</text>
</svg>
